RocketBaseBossFThrashText:
We can't have a
brat like you on the loose.

It's harmful to
TEAM ROCKET's pride, you see.

However strong you
may be, you can't

take both of us at
the same time.

Sorry, baby. Now
get ready to be thrashed.
RocketBaseLanceShareFunText:
Hey! Don't be so
selfish. Spread the fun around.
RocketBaseBossDontMeddleText:
What? You had an
accomplice?

Where is your
sense of honor?

As the interim
boss in place of

GIOVANNI, I'll
show you how wrong

it is to meddle
with TEAM ROCKET!
RocketBaseBossWinText:
Tch, you really
are strong.

It's too bad.

If you were to
join TEAM ROCKET,

you could become
an EXECUTIVE.
RocketBaseBossRetreatText:
…This hideout is
done for…

But that's fine.
The broadcast ex- periment was a total success.

It doesn't matter
what happens to this hideout now.

We have much big-
ger plans.

You'll come to
appreciate TEAM

ROCKET's true
power soon enough.

Enjoy yourself
while you can…

Fufufufu…
RocketBaseLancePostBattleText:
LANCE: That did
it. We defeated

all the ROCKETS
here.

But I'm concerned
about the young

guy I battled in
the process…
RocketBaseLancePowerOffText:
Sorry, .
I saw how well you

were doing, so I
just hung back.

Now all there is
left to do is to

turn off that odd
radio signal.
RockerBaseLanceElectrodeFaintText:
It's this machine
that's causing all the problems.

I don't see a
switch on it…

We have no choice.
We have to make

all the ELECTRODE
faint.

That should stop
this machine from

transmitting that
strange signal.

It's no fault of
the #MON, so it

makes me feel
guilty.

, let's
split the job.
RocketBaseLancesSideText:
LANCE: Leave this
side to me.
RocketBaseLanceElectrodeDoneText:
LANCE: That odd
signal has finally stopped.

The LAKE should be
back to normal.

You're the hero!
Let me thank you

on behalf of all
the #MON.

Oh, yes. You
should take this.

I found it here,
but I don't have any need for it.
RocketBaseLanceWhirlpoolText:
That's WHIRLPOOL.
Teach it to a

#MON to get
across wild water.

But keep this in
mind.

You can use that
out of battle only

with the BADGE
from MAHOGANY GYM.
RocketBaseLanceMonMasterText:
…

The journey to be-
coming the #MON

MASTER is long and
difficult.

Knowing that, will
you keep going?

…

I see. No, you're
right.

If you would give
up that easily,

you would have
never chased that

dream in the first
place.

I look forward to
seeing you again!
LanceHealsText1:
LANCE: Are you all
right?

Your #MON are
hurt and tired.

Here, give them
some of my medi- cine.
LanceHealsText2:
LANCE: ,
let's give it our best for #MON.
GruntM17SeenText:
The door won't
open?

Well, duh.
It has to have a

password that only
TEAM ROCKET knows.
GruntM17AfterBattleText:
Heh, I'm just a
GRUNT.

I don't know the
password. Too bad for you.
GruntM18SeenText:
Oh, a kid? I don't
really like this,

but eliminate you
I must.
GruntM18AfterBattleText:
I got wiped out on
the last mission by a kid too.

When we were ab-
ducting #MON,

this kid with long
red hair and mean-

looking eyes just
creamed me…
GruntM19AfterBattleText:
Heh, only the boss
knows the password for that door.

Where's the boss?
Who knows? Go look for yourself.
RocketBaseDoorNoPasswordText:
The door's closed…

It needs a pass-
word to open.
RocketBaseDoorKnowPasswordText:
The door's closed…

{PLAYER} entered
the password.

The door opened!
RocketBaseB2FTransmitterText:
It's the radio
transmitter that's

sending the
sinister signal.

It's working at
full capacity.
RocketBaseB2FDeactivateTransmitterText:
The radio trans-
mitter has finally

stopped its evil
broadcast.
